label: PF Backlog 492
title: Fix: generalize the code-review agent card (drop hardcoded mymoney/13-features/apps/Phase lists; drive from requirements/plan)
body:
Source: user review of `.opencode/agent/code-review.md` (2026-10-08).

PROBLEM: the Code Review agent card mixes GENERIC criteria with EXAMPLE-SPECIFIC hardcoding from one product:
"mymoney", a fixed "13 features", `apps/` paths, and hardcoded Phase 1-4 feature lists. So on any other product
the reviewer checks the WRONG feature set / wrong paths, and "All 13 features implemented" is meaningless.

FIX: generalize the card to be data-driven:
- requirements: enumerate ALL FRs from docs/requirements.md (dynamic count), not "FR-1..FR-13".
- features: read docs/feature-status.md / product-plan.json (or the backlog) for the actual feature set; no "13".
- paths: discover source dirs from the project layout (Glob), not hardcoded apps/.
- phase-aware review: derive phases from the plan (only phases that exist), not a fixed 4.
- guidelines: load the guidelines that EXIST via a registry/glob, not a fixed list.
Keep the sound generic criteria (reject scaffolding/mocks; real APIs; tests pass; plan-alignment; read-only;
evidence required; reports/code-review.md contract). Keep the agent-card standard structure (wired_audit
role-prompts must still pass).

Acceptance: card has no product-specific literals (mymoney/13/apps/Phase lists); criteria driven by the project's
own requirements/features/paths; wired_audit role-prompts green; a run still produces reports/code-review.md.
